goal: NET testing review: test isolation, fakes for I/O, coverage of branches and flaky tests.
use: NET testing review: test isolation, fakes for I/O, coverage of branches and flaky tests. Use when a .NET test project is added or changed.

steps.note: List the test projects and what each one covers.
Check isolation. Flag tests that call real databases, networks or the clock.
Check fakes. Each external dependency should have a fake or stub.
Check flakiness. Flag tests that depend on timing or order.
Report. Each finding with file and line, the problem and the fix.
